description: For a user who wants lottery numbers drawn from a sentence of their own (a wish, a name, a question). Give the sentence and the lottery format (a game, or custom count and max with optional extras); the answer is one prismtect.com link. The user opens it and prismtect.com draws the numbers from their sentence there; this tool makes no numbers. Ranges: min 0 or 1, max up to 99, at most 8 numbers in all. The link works for 30 days.

extra_count.description: custom: how many extra (bonus) numbers, drawn apart.

extra_max.description: custom: the largest extra number (extras start at 1).

game.description: A game, or "custom" with count and max. May be left out when count and max are given.

text.description: The user's sentence, 1 to 500 characters, no line breaks.

name: sentence_numbers_link
title: Numbers from the user's own sentence (a link)
